ranking.population: Case-normalized nonempty actor logins with at least one observed public PushEvent in the same window; automated accounts included.

source.transport: Live HTTP GET through Firecrawl; maxAge=0; HTTP 200

ranking.target_sql:
SELECT count() AS push_events, uniqExact(repo_name) AS repositories_pushed,
min(created_at) AS first_push, max(created_at) AS last_push
FROM github_events
WHERE event_type = 'PushEvent' AND lowerUTF8(actor_login) = '4444j99'
AND created_at >= '2025-10-01 00:00:00' AND created_at < '2026-07-01 00:00:00'
FORMAT JSON
ranking.cohort_sql:
SELECT count() AS active_accounts,
countIf(pushes > 4905) AS accounts_strictly_above,
countIf(pushes = 4905) AS accounts_tied,
countIf(pushes >= 35000) AS accounts_at_least_35000_pushes,
quantileExact(0.99)(pushes) AS p99_pushes, sum(pushes) AS total_push_events
FROM (SELECT lowerUTF8(actor_login) AS login, count() AS pushes
FROM github_events WHERE event_type = 'PushEvent' AND actor_login != ''
AND created_at >= '2025-10-01 00:00:00' AND created_at < '2026-07-01 00:00:00'
GROUP BY login) FORMAT JSON

derived.rounding: Ceiling to 0.001 percentage points; ties included in upper-tail share.

limits: Public events observed in this dataset, not a census of private GitHub activity.
Accounts are not verified unique people; automation and bots are included.
PushEvent counts are not unique authored commits, contribution-calendar totals, or Python-only commits.
Historical repository-name strings may include forks, renames and transfers; 345 is not an owned-original-repository count.
The source is mutable. This frozen aggregate records the observed result; it is not a frozen copy of every underlying event.
The queried schema has no event ID; counts use the source rows as ingested, without independent event-level deduplication.

coverage_check.decision: Use complete calendar months October through June, not the incomplete requested trailing year. Presence of month boundaries is not an audit of every hourly archive.
coverage_check.push_size_warning: All observed PushEvent rows from November 2025 through June 2026 had push_size=0. Do not sum this missing field or substitute the PR commits field for authored commits.

profile.attestation: API-derived repository manifest, not a fresh GraphQL contribution collection fetched in this verification.
profile.scope_note: Repository and language figures use the manifest ecosystem scope, not the older LAVREA visible-repository scope. Contributions and active days use its trailing-year calendar.

historical_python_distinction.provenance: Anthony states recruiters discovered and approached him using this statistic and he subsequently verified it with ChatGPT.
historical_python_distinction.relationship_to_new_ranking: Separate historical finding; the measured public push-event ranking neither reproduces nor disproves the Python-only calculation.
historical_python_distinction.retention_rule: Preserve attribution and history. Missing prior context or withdrawal of a different heuristic is not disproof; a status change needs explicit contradictory evidence.
